title: Monthly Outstanding Balance Reduction
context: Monthly outstanding customer balances required structured follow-up and prioritization.
action: Implemented structured customer notification and follow-up controls, using TechLoc telemetry, location, movement, and inventory intelligence to prioritize accounts and assets.
impact: Reduced monthly outstanding customer balances by approximately 91% through structured notification, follow-up controls, and operational prioritization.
source: User-provided Operations & Inventory Control achievement; TechLoc case study.

title: Reduction in Monthly Out-for-Repossession Volume
context: A high number of vehicles were regularly being placed Out for Repossession.
action: Used earlier customer intervention, improved inventory visibility, asset location and movement information, and TechLoc operational intelligence to identify risk sooner.
impact: Reduced monthly vehicles placed Out for Repossession by approximately 60%.
source: User-provided Operations & Inventory Control achievement; TechLoc case study.

title: Active Fleet Inventory Visibility
context: The active commercial-truck inventory requires continuous location and operational-status visibility.
action: Integrated inventory controls, vehicle status, GPS/telemetry information, and operational follow-up.
impact: Maintained current operational and inventory visibility across more than 300 trucks.
